pages.title: Candy Swipe
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Trace a path through three or more matching sweets in Candy Swipe. Longer matches can help you earn better rewards, and you can use those rewards to clear more pieces. Look for keys when locks get in the way. Keep checking the board after each swipe for the next group you can connect.

pages.title: Pop Flower
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Sort flowers from bubbles into pots in Pop Flower. Pick blooms that can go together and build sets of three identical flowers in a single pot. A finished set clears and leaves space for more. Think about where the other flowers can go before using the last available spot.

pages.title: Drop Four Evolved
pages.creator: Playful Cochon
pages.description: Drop pieces into columns and try to connect four in Drop Four Evolved. Build toward a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line while watching for a line your opponent could finish. A piece lands on top of what's already in its column, so think about what your move makes possible on the next turn.

pages.title: Pharaoh Runner: Ancient Escape
pages.creator: nono
pages.description: Sprint through temples and ruins in Pharaoh Runner: Ancient Escape. Jump past obstacles and slide under swinging ceiling spikes as you make your way through ancient Egypt. Look out for pottery traps and collect golden scarab coins when you have a clear route. See how far you can make it in one run.

pages.title: Bug Burrow Wars
pages.creator: Nova Logic Ventures
pages.description: Send insects down three tunnels in Bug Burrow Wars. Choose a lane and deploy a squad to break the enemy gates and reach the heart of its colony. Use boosts such as Freeze or Repair when a lane needs help. Unlock 24 bugs and take on five giant bosses as you advance.

pages.title: Dig & Flow - Save Water
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Dig through sand to guide water, lava, and steam in Dig & Flow - Save Water. Carve routes through the maze so each stream can collect stars or activate a mechanism. The elements behave differently, so a path that works for water may need to change for steam. Open new routes as you solve each layout.

pages.title: Snake Go - Escape Puzzle
pages.creator: Kankane Games
pages.description: Guide snakes out of crowded grids in Snake Go - Escape Puzzle. Look for a clear route before moving and work out which snake needs to leave first. A move that frees one path can give another snake room to escape. Keep the tight spaces in mind as you decide the order.

pages.title: Stack Tower Pro
pages.creator: KDS Group
pages.description: Build a skyscraper by lining up blocks in Stack Tower Pro. Watch the next block's position and time your placement so it sits on the layer below. Keep placing pieces as the tower grows and see how high you can reach. Unlock themes to change the look of the stack.

pages.title: Ninja Obby Parkour
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Race through obstacle courses in Ninja Obby Parkour. Use ninja moves to break glass doors at checkpoints and look for bonuses such as extra speed, giant mode, or flight. The courses mix fast movement with hazards that take timing to clear. Customize your ninja as you take on more routes.

pages.title: Toy Match 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Match toys across more than 4,100 levels in Toy Match 3. Look for groups that help with the current puzzle, then see what falls into place after a match. Try daily missions and weekly challenges alongside the main levels. Take part in quests such as the Treasure Hunt to earn more rewards.

pages.title: Girly Puzzle
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Place block shapes on a grid in Girly Puzzle. Complete a horizontal or vertical line to open space for later pieces, and collect items to add to your score. Think about where larger shapes can still fit before filling the small gaps. The game ends when no remaining block can be placed.

pages.title: Cooking Cafe Food Chef
pages.creator: Rendered Ideas
pages.description: Cook and serve dishes against the clock in Cooking Cafe Food Chef. Keep track of customer orders while preparing food from different cuisines. Finish each level's mission to advance and unlock other cafés and restaurants. Decide what to cook next so you can keep up as more customers arrive.

pages.title: Typing Adventure
pages.creator: Cat Summer
pages.description: Stop enemies by typing the words above them in Typing Adventure. Pick a target and finish its word before it reaches you. The enemies come faster the longer you survive, leaving less time to correct a mistake. Keep your eyes on the approaching wave and see how long your typing can hold it off.

pages.title: Hidden Easter Egg Hunt
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Look for eggs tucked into spring scenes in Hidden Easter Egg Hunt. Search around flowers, fields, and bunnies for shapes that blend into the background. Check a different part of the picture if an egg is hard to find. Work through the scenes by finding the eggs hidden in each one.

pages.title: Astral Escape
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Rotate puzzle pieces to help an astronaut reach safety in Astral Escape. Look at how each turn changes the route and keep hazards in mind as you work out the layout. Set the pieces in the right positions to solve the space-themed puzzle before moving to the next one.

pages.title: Cyberpunk City Fashion
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Give Belle, Ariel, Moana, and Elsa futuristic looks in Cyberpunk City Fashion. Choose outfits for the four friends against a backdrop of neon city lights. Try a different style for each princess and compare how the pieces work together. Put together the looks you want them to wear into the city.

pages.title: IDLE Ships
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Build a ship one stage at a time in IDLE Ships. Gather materials automatically or click the materials button to add more, then spend them on the current part of the vessel. Upgrade production to earn materials faster, or buy supplies with in-game currency when you want to keep the build moving.

pages.title: 2048 Ballz
pages.creator: VarCo
pages.description: Merge balls of the same color in 2048 Ballz. Bring matching balls together to make a new one and use the way they roll and settle to set up future merges. Keep some room for the next ball as the pile grows. See how high you can push your score in the endless puzzle.

pages.title: Stickman Battle Ultimate Fight
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description: Survive a gladiator arena in Stickman Battle Ultimate Fight. Stay clear of stronger opponents while you gather items that give you new powers. Use what you find to build up your fighter before taking on harder rivals. Keep moving around the arena so you can look for pickups without getting cornered.

pages.title: Zombie Island 3D
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Search an island for ammunition and health packs in Zombie Island 3D. Use the supplies you find to stay alive while taking out the zombies around you. Keep track of where the undead are moving before you go after a pickup. Clear the island of zombies to survive the encounter.

pages.title: Beehive Yourself
pages.creator: Monish Vyas
pages.description: Lead a bee to its hive in Beehive Yourself. Move the mouse cursor to guide her and leave enough room between the bee and the walls. Pick up stars along the way if you can reach them safely. Get to the hive without bumping into the maze to finish the route.

pages.title: Sky Rolling Balls
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Roll a ball forward to collect rings in Sky Rolling Balls. Hold to move and watch where the next circle is before you advance. Gather every circle to finish the level. Later routes ask you to collect more of them, so keep track of what's still ahead.

pages.title: Free Flow
pages.creator: Dumadu Games Pvt Ltd
pages.description: Join matching dots without crossing any lines in Free Flow. Draw a path between each pair of the same color and check that it leaves room for the other connections. Start with pairs that have fewer ways to reach each other. Complete all the links to solve the grid.

pages.title: Tictoc Paris Fashion
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Put together looks for a trip to Paris in Tictoc Paris Fashion. Follow the styling hints as you choose makeup, clothes, hair, and accessories. See how many likes the finished look gets in each reel. Use the money you earn to buy new pieces for the next outfit.

pages.title: Soul and Dragon
pages.creator: MySoulGames
pages.description: Build a fighter who can use magic as well as weapons in Soul and Dragon. Try characters from groups such as humans, goblins, elves, or dragons. Take on the adventure, climb the endless tower, or enter the arena. Forge equipment and develop your character as you work through the different modes.

pages.title: Puzzlez
pages.creator: PKPL Entertainment
pages.description: Try a collection of logic puzzles in Puzzlez. Choose a puzzle and read its instructions before you make your first move, since the rules change between games. Work through hand-designed layouts at your own pace. Switch to another puzzle type when you want a different problem to solve.

pages.title: Color Up
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Guide a bouncing ball up colored platforms in Color Up. Passing through a beam changes the ball to that beam's color. Slide the ball toward a platform that now matches it and avoid landing on the wrong color. Keep adjusting after each beam to climb farther and score more.

pages.title: Pac Chef
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Guide a chef through a maze in Pac Chef. Collect the coins and recipe ingredients while steering clear of rival cooks. Ingredients can give you special powers to deal with them. Gather what the recipe needs and clear the level before the other chefs get in your way.

pages.title: Big Blocks Battle
pages.creator: Booblyc OU
pages.description: Knock blue blocks off the screen in Big Blocks Battle. Choose a cannonball and pull back the plunger to set up a shot, then release to fire. Keep the green blocks on the board as you aim at the blue ones. Score enough points to clear each of the 35 levels.

pages.title: Monster Race 3D
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Race monster trucks across ten tracks in Monster Race 3D. Drive with WASD in the first player position or the arrow keys in the second. Try the tournament alone or share the keyboard with a friend. Keep control through each course as you work toward a first-place finish.

pages.title: Witch Magic Academy
pages.creator: TastyCherryGames
pages.description: Gather herbs and other ingredients in Witch Magic Academy. Use them to brew a shapeshifting potion and see what your choices turn you into. Click or tap to explore and solve the tasks that lead to the ingredients. Save your finished transformation on a collectible card.

pages.title: Super Fashion Stylist Dress up 3d Dress Up Games
pages.creator: Lover3d
pages.description: Style a model and set up a photo in Super Fashion Stylist Dress up 3d Dress Up Games. Choose from more than 80 designs in five categories. Pick a pose and location for the photo with your partner. See how the styling is scored and try another combination for a different shoot.

pages.title: Futoshiki
pages.creator: SBC Games
pages.description: Fill each row and column with the numbers one through five in Futoshiki. Use every number once per line and follow the greater-than and less-than signs between cells. Turn on notes when you need to track possible values. Pick a difficulty and work toward the puzzle's single solution.

pages.title: Monster Match
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description: Make lines of matching monsters in Monster Match. Look for three or more of the same kind that can be lined up on the board. Clearing a group changes what's left to work with, so check the new pattern after each match. Keep finding combinations to remove more monsters.

pages.title: Fruit Legions: Monsters Siege
pages.creator: Simplegame
pages.description: Help plants defend their home in Fruit Legions: Monsters Siege. Arrange crops into a formation and use the fruits they grow as weapons. Move the defenders by dragging and dropping them where they can help. Set up a line that can hold back enemies approaching the fortress.

pages.title: Mr. Lupato 2 Egyptian Pyramids Treasures
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Explore pyramid passages in Mr. Lupato 2 Egyptian Pyramids Treasures. Collect gems and keys to open the doors, and look for hidden items along the way. You have a limited number of jumps, so use them carefully around snakes and spiders. Work through 15 levels and use extra jumps when you find them.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Dressmaker Dressup
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Dress Baby Hazel for a new job in Baby Hazel Dressmaker Dressup. Browse the clothes and accessories before she starts sewing for customers. Try different combinations to find a look that suits her work as a dressmaker. Use the mouse or touch to change the pieces until she's ready.

pages.title: Elastic Car
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Steer and control your speed by sliding in Elastic Car. Watch where other vehicles are and adjust your pace before moving past them. Pick up the yellow car to become temporarily invincible, then use that time to crash into and collect other vehicles. Keep driving to improve your score.

pages.title: Birds of Prey Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble pictures of raptors in Birds of Prey Puzzle. Pick from six images and solve each with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Look at the feathers, outlines, and background details to find where the pieces fit. Try the same image with a larger piece count for a harder puzzle.

pages.title: Adventure Hero
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Collect fruit and trophies as you cross platforms in Adventure Hero. Use the arrow keys or onscreen buttons to move. Look for a route to each pickup that takes you past enemies and obstacles safely. Keep watching where you can land before jumping for a piece of fruit.

pages.title: Fishing Boy
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Fish for more than just fish in Fishing Boy. Move with the onscreen buttons or arrow keys and lower your line for creatures, shells, and other pickups. Look out for sharks and bubbles that carry items such as bombs, worms, or treasure. Collect what you can to improve your score.

pages.title: TNT
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Click barrels before they explode in TNT. Watch for the barrels that turn red first and deal with those before moving on. Their colors tell you where the danger is building. Keep scanning the group and see how many barrels you can destroy before one goes off.

pages.title: Snow Driving Car Racer Track Simulator
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Race and drift on snowy city roads in Snow Driving Car Racer Track Simulator. Watch how the car slides as you take a turn on ice, then straighten it out for the next stretch. Give yourself room to recover from a drift. The snowy tracks put control and speed to the test together.

pages.title: Beer Slide
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Keep a glass sliding along a bar in Beer Slide. Tap to jump over obstacles without spilling the drink. The glass speeds up and slows down unpredictably, so watch how fast the next obstacle is approaching before you jump. See how far you can go along the endless table.

pages.title: SHAPE ADJUST
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Change your shape to match the opening in SHAPE ADJUST. Press Space or click the left mouse button to swap forms as the next obstacle comes up. Look at its outline before you act so you have time to choose the right shape. Keep moving through the openings without a mismatch.

pages.title: Running Horse Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild images of running horses in Running Horse Slide. Pick one of three pictures and a puzzle mode, then slide the sections until the image lines up. Look for parts of a horse or the landscape that continue from one piece to another. Try a new mode for a different arrangement.

pages.title: Impossible Tracks Prado Car Stunt Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Drive a Prado on narrow stunt tracks in Impossible Tracks Prado Car Stunt Game. Line up the car before you head onto a ramp and control your speed as the course changes. Try the jumps without falling off the elevated route. Each stretch asks you to balance momentum with precise steering.

pages.title: Perfect Pipes
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Join pipe sections so a ball can reach its jar in Perfect Pipes. Look at how the pipe ends are positioned and make the connections that lead to the container. Check for an opening along the route before sending the ball through. Finish the path to solve the layout.

pages.title: Word Stickers!
pages.creator: Eery Lab s.c.
pages.description: Find words hidden in the letter grid in Word Stickers! Swipe across or down to select a word and watch the remaining letters collapse into a new arrangement. Keep searching until you've cleared the grid. There is no timer, so you can take your time with the harder layouts.

pages.title: Banana Split
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Put together a dessert in Banana Split. Start with a banana and add vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry ice cream. Choose syrups and finish with toppings such as chopped nuts, whipped cream, and maraschino cherries. Build the dessert in a long dish and see how the finished combination looks.

pages.title: IMVU SPIN Earn Unlimited Credits
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Spin a wheel for points in IMVU SPIN Earn Unlimited Credits. After the first spin, a second wheel gives you a chance to increase the score or lose the points from that round. Watch where each pointer lands and see what the two spins leave you with.

pages.title: Big Trucks And Cars Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Turn over cards and match pictures of trucks and cars in Big Trucks And Cars Memory. Remember where each vehicle appears so you can find its partner later. Clear all the pairs in each of four levels. Try to finish using as few turns as possible.

pages.title: Mushroom Adventure
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Guide a mushroom through a platform course in Mushroom Adventure. Use the arrow keys to move and watch where you can land before making a jump. Collect coins along the route while keeping clear of enemies and hazards. Keep going through the platforms to build your score.

pages.title: Flappy Rocket
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Guide a rocket between columns in Flappy Rocket. Click the left mouse button or press Space to keep it in the air. Watch the height of the next opening and adjust before you reach it. Keep clearing gaps to see how far you can fly without hitting a column.

pages.title: Horik Viking
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Cross a Nordic valley in Horik Viking. Guide Horik through ten side-scrolling levels in search of the stars of Oddin. Watch for dragons while you move between platforms and look for a route to the next star. Get past the creatures and hazards to finish the journey.

pages.title: Jelly Cute Rush
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Connect matching jelly beans in Jelly Cute Rush. Find pieces of the same kind that you can join in one chain, then draw the link to collect them. Check the remaining pieces after the match and look for another group. Longer chains let you pick up more jelly beans in one move.

pages.title: Flippy Journey
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Move between platforms in Flippy Journey. Use the arrow keys to send the character left or right and watch where the next landing will take you. Avoid traps as you cross the level and collect coins when there's a safe route. Spend the coins on skins and different platform styles.

pages.title: Santa's Dream
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Collect Christmas ornaments in Santa's Dream. Use the arrow keys to move Santa left and right and steer him away from obstacles. Look at what's ahead before crossing for a pickup. Keep collecting ornaments while you find a safe route through the next stretch.

pages.title: Christmas Deer Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Solve ten holiday pictures in Christmas Deer Jigsaw. Drag pieces into place and earn in-game money to unlock the next image. Each picture has three modes, and the hardest one pays more when you finish it. Look for parts of the deer and surrounding scene that line up across the edges.

pages.title: Ball.io
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Clear a path for a rolling ball in Ball.io. Use the mouse to move obstacles out of the route before the ball reaches them. Watch farther ahead when one part of the track is already clear. Keep the ball moving until it makes it across the finish line.

pages.title: Stack The Blocks
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Build a tower by dragging and dropping pieces in Stack The Blocks. Watch how each block settles under its own weight before adding another. A wide, steady landing gives you room for the next piece. Keep stacking and see how many blocks you can place before the structure gives way.

pages.title: Fun Run Race 3D
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Race through an obstacle course in Fun Run Race 3D. Press the Up arrow to run and watch the hazards before moving into their path. Stop when a hurdle is in the way and take the opening when it clears. Get through the entire course to win the level.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Gums Treatment
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Go to the dentist with Hazel in Baby Hazel Gums Treatment. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel and the other characters as they get ready for the visit. Help the dentist through the steps of caring for Hazel's gums. The story follows the trip from getting ready at home to treatment at the clinic.

pages.title: Parrot And Friends
pages.creator: Tori Games
pages.description: Move and rotate falling shapes in Parrot And Friends. Fill rows to clear them and look for combinations that make room for more pieces. Use the arrow keys or onscreen gamepad and see how long you can keep the stack under control. Work toward level ten and compare your score with other players.

pages.title: Geometry Dash: Mr Dubstep
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Jump, drop, and switch gravity in Geometry Dash: Mr Dubstep. Left-click to jump or double-jump, right-click to drop, and press Space to reverse gravity. Use boosts and special powers when a stretch calls for them. Try the 15 levels, unlock more characters, or see how far you can go in endless mode.

pages.title: Ice Queen Ruined Wedding
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Repair the wedding after a snow monster crashes it in Ice Queen Ruined Wedding. Go from room to room to fix the plates, window, and cake. Once the damage is sorted out, pick a dress for the Ice Queen. Help her get everything ready before the celebration can start again.

pages.title: EG Rico Orange
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Keep a small green orange inside a larger one in EG Rico Orange. Move the paddle behind it to send it back toward the middle when it approaches the edge. The speed rises as you play, leaving less time to get into position. Keep it inside to earn more points.

pages.title: Draw Here
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Draw shapes that fall onto stars in Draw Here. Use the marked drawing area and think about how gravity will move a shape once you finish it. Change its position or outline when it misses a star. Clear the stars to solve each of the 100 levels.

pages.title: Fashion Academy
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Study two styles with Barbara in Fashion Academy. Start with a streetwear look and decide which dress fits it. Then try putting together a wedding outfit for a different kind of styling challenge. Choose pieces that suit each occasion as you work through the academy's activities.

pages.title: Plumber Pipe Out
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Turn pipe pieces to prevent a flood in Plumber Pipe Out. Line up open ends until they form a continuous pipe and bring the water level down. Look for connections you can finish before the water overflows. Choose from five difficulty modes and work through 250 layouts.

pages.title: Car Mayhem
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Drive a van that fires as you go in Car Mayhem. Destroy objects in your path to earn money and see how much damage you can do along the route. Spend the earnings on better van stats or special weapons. Take your upgraded vehicle out again and try it against more targets.

pages.title: Ice Princess Halloween Preps
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get a princess ready for a Halloween party in Ice Princess Halloween Preps. Browse the outfits and pick a costume, then add themed makeup to go with it. Try different combinations before settling on the finished look. Make the costume and makeup work together for the celebration.

pages.title: Knight of Magic
pages.creator: littlegiantworld
pages.description: Fight demons with magic in Knight of Magic. Use attacks to deal with the creatures that come at you in waves and watch for stronger enemies among them. Develop your hero's abilities as you play. Keep fighting to see how many waves you can handle and how high you can score.

pages.title: Robbers in Town
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Control two thieves at once in Robbers in Town. Tap right for the first robber and left for the second. Collect money bags and watch the hazards on both routes, because losing either robber ends the attempt for both. Work through 16 levels spread across four themes.

pages.title: Forest Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Find five stars hidden in each forest scene in Forest Hidden Stars. Look closely at the trees and background details where a star might blend in. There is no timer, so you can search at your own pace. Find all five to unlock the next picture.

pages.title: Barbara Fashion Hair Saloon
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Create a new hairstyle for Barbie in Barbara Fashion Hair Saloon. Browse the hair options and use the salon items to put together a style you like. Try another combination if you want something different from her usual look. Use the mouse or touch to make the changes.

pages.title: One Touch Football
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Pass the ball and finish with a goal in One Touch Football. Watch where your teammate is before you make a pass, then look for an opening to send the ball into the net. Score to move to the next challenge and work your way through all 20 levels.

pages.title: Mahjong Titans
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear a layout of traditional tiles in Mahjong Titans. Click two identical tiles when both are free, with nothing on top and a side open. Removing a pair can uncover another useful match. Keep checking what has become available until the playing field is empty.

pages.title: Emily's Ice Cream Shop
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Serve customers from a busy ice cream truck in Emily's Ice Cream Shop. Check what each person orders and prepare it quickly enough to keep the line moving. Look at the next order while finishing the one in front of you. The challenge is serving each customer what they asked for under time pressure.

pages.title: Punk Princess Garderobe 2
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Give a princess a punk makeover in Punk Princess Garderobe 2. Start with intense makeup colors and try a bold blush. Move on to the wardrobe and choose pieces that fit the makeup you've put together. Add accessories to finish the outfit before she heads out in her new look.

pages.title: Sery Wedding Dolly Dress Up
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Open boxes and build a bridal look in Sery Wedding Dolly Dress Up. Choose a dress, shoes, and accessories from the pieces you uncover. The finished outfit earns a rating, so try different combinations to aim for five stars. Work toward more achievements with each look you create.
